issues.description: Method name mismatch for the operation that feeds all animals: the template's commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java calls farm.feed(); whereas the problem statement describes a Farm method named feedAllAnimals() and the reference solution implements public void feedAllAnimals() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java. This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual operation can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent. E.g., update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals(); so it matches the problem statement and reference solution. Alternatively, if a shorter name was intended, add a public void feed() wrapper in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java that delegates to feedAllAnimals() and update the problem statement and solution accordingly; prefer updating the Main.java comment to use feedAllAnimals() to avoid changing the exercise API.
